content.value: The velocity and enthalpy of fluid at the inlet of a certain nozzle are 50 m/s and 2850 kJ/kg, respectively. The enthalpy at the exit of the nozzle is 2570 kJ/kg. The nozzle is horizontal and insulated. Find (i) the velocity of the fluid at the exit of the nozzle; (ii) the mass flow rate, if the area at inlet of nozzle is 0.09 m<sup>2</sup> and the specific volume is 0.185 m<sup>3</sup> /kg; (iii) the exit area of the nozzle, if the specific volume at the exit of the nozzle is 0.495 m3 /kg.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
